kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-key-pairs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-key-pair-name KeyPairName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListKeyPairs

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to ensure that different requests use unique values. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the key pair list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对列表的页码。起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size
